title: catalyst migrate
description: What `catalyst migrate [--apply] --json` prints: what the deployment is behind on, as it stood before any step was taken — a legacy layout, the templates its kernel and modules ship that it does not hold, the steps its migrations leave to a person — and, with --apply, what was done (catalyst >= 0.102.0).

criterion.description: The criterion; null when it is not on this machine.

kernel.description: The kernel the criterion is at.

since.description: The kernel the judgment steps are listed from: `--since`, else the kernel before the last sync; null when the journal names none.

target.description: The project, the template file to add, or the migration's owner and version.

auto.description: Whether `--apply` takes it without being asked: a layout, a kernel template.

type.description: A module template step's type prefix: `--template <it>` takes it.
